newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Swire shares still weak after results.
newsitem.headline: Swire shares still weak after results.

text.p: Shares of conglomerate Swire Pacific Ltd continued to fall on Monday after the group posted disappointing 1996 earnings on Friday, analysts said.
Despite a positive tone in the overall market, the stock was down HK$0.75 at HK$60.75 after touching a low of HK$60.50.
"The fall is largely related to its 1996 earnings which were boosted mainly by exceptionals," said Kinson Au at PW Asia.

Swire posted an 18.6 percent rise in 1996 net profit to HK$7.65 billion, including a HK$1.58 billion exceptional gain mostly from the sale of the JW Marriott Hotel Hong Kong and a stake in Hong Kong Dragon Airlines.
The stock fell HK$1.25 on Friday.
Brokers said Swire shares should find support at current levels because the company still had strong property development and investment portfolios.
